stories.subject: Lil Baby
stories.update: FRESH releases Nov. 6 via Quality Control and Motown as a 17-track album with Future, Young Thug and Rylo Rodriguez on All My Partnas; Pharrell produced Dead Fresh.

stories.subject: GloRilla and Sexyy Red
stories.update: GloRilla responded to criticism of Jiggly Bow Bow; Complex reports the CMG/Interscope single is set for Nov. 6, while Glo's official site lists the release and the label-linked pre-save.

stories.subject: Takeoff trial
stories.update: Patrick Xavier Clark's jury trial in Takeoff's killing is listed for Apr. 15, 2027; reporting cites scheduling conflicts and newly disclosed evidence, and Clark maintains his innocence.

stories.subject: Nicki Minaj
stories.update: Former counsel renewed a request for a $295,605 default award tied to unpaid fees from the I Lied copyright case; the underlying copyright suit ended in a private settlement and the fee hearing is Nov. 16.

stories.subject: Sean Combs / Diddy
stories.update: Sher Tremonte says $581,893.75 is owed for one defamation case involving Courtney Burgess, Ariel Mitchell and Nexstar; the judge must still decide the lien and amount.
